title: Which split explains this span?
hook: Recognizing every letter does not yet recognize the whole sentence.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Prefix codes, strings, grammar productions and a stack.
doesNotKnow: Recognize a CNF grammar string by combining nonterminals across every span split.

misconception: A successful prefix parse proves the remaining whole string is grammatical.
objective: Recognize a CNF grammar string by combining nonterminals across every span split.

claims.text: Each cell stores all nonterminals deriving that span. A binary rule contributes only when its two children derive adjacent subspans at some split. Acceptance requires the start symbol in the full-span cell, not merely valid individual letters.
